result.reason: The clause reaches an acceptable fallback position: Customer retains a roughly one-month notice right, which is more favorable than the fallback’s 60–90 days, early-termination charges are capped at three months of fees, and prepaid post-termination fees are refunded pro rata. No Vendor convenience-termination right is added. The edits are targeted and preserve the attachment structure and prerequisite-services carveout. Drafting is professional, though the cap could be slightly clearer by referring expressly to three months of recurring fees for the terminated Services.
